decisions.reason: As a flagship extension of the core cloud messaging platform and the firm's announced direction, the sunk investment and public commitment make management very likely to continue and treat any remaining weakness as manageable within the broader portfolio.

This service is less visible than the flagship products but still uses established messaging capabilities for regulated customers, so management is inclined to retain it rather than admit a mistaken adjacent launch.

Because this is a narrower fax-related feature with lower public commitment and weaker fit with the longer-term innovation narrative, it is the most vulnerable, but management still has reasons to keep an invested-in support feature for existing customers.
Threat protection remains closely tied to the firm's secure and compliant positioning, so accumulated investment and reputational commitment strongly favor persistence.
